name: PT Diamond Food Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Diamond Food Indonesia Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and distributes food and beverage products in Indonesia and internationally. The company offers cheese, chocolates, creams, ice creams, juices, mayonnaise, milk, premixes, and yogurt and desserts under the Diamond, Jungle Juice, Biokul, Brookfarm. PT diamond food indonesia tbk was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Jakarta Pusat, Indonesia.
